entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling about an order from a couple of months back. I bought a VeloFit performance jersey, but I seem to have ordered the wrong size.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you happen to have the order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... I see the Aero-Tech Jersey, delivered about 70 days ago. To make sure I'm on the right page, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference with the fit?
It's just the fit. The jersey is a little too tight across the chest. I'd like to do an exchange for the next size up if possible.
Understood, thank you for clarifying. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for that specific product... One moment.

Okay, great news. That jersey is a standard apparel item, which falls under our 10-day return policy. Since you're within that window, I can definitely process an exchange for the correct size for you right now.

That's wonderful, thank you for making that so easy. I do have one small question. Since I'll have to go through the trouble of packaging this up and shipping it back, and I've been a VIP member for a few years, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase for the inconvenience?

That's a fair question, and we absolutely value your loyalty. While our system doesn't allow for discount codes on standard exchanges, as a valued VIP member, I can upgrade the shipping on your replacement jersey to our complimentary 2-day express service. Would that work for you?
Oh, getting the right size shipped that quickly would be fantastic. Yes, that works perfectly. Thank you, Charlie!

You're very welcome. I have initiated the exchange. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid return label within the next 15 minutes. As soon as the carrier scans your return package, your new size will be dispatched with that express shipping. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
